posts.title: How SolveMpire Takes Products from Concept to Deployment
posts.subtitle: The 6-Stage Turnkey Product Engineering Methodology: Mechanical CAD, Custom PCBs, Embedded Firmware, and Factory Mass Manufacturing.
posts.excerpt: An inside look at SolveMpire's proprietary 6-Stage Engineering Process. Discover how our integrated studio takes complex electromechanical products from napkin sketch requirements to multi-layer KiCad schematics, 3D parametric CAD, functional prototypes, factory tooling qualification, and 10-year field fleet support.

posts.title: Cost of Developing an Industrial Machine in India
posts.subtitle: A Transparent Financial & Engineering Breakdown: Mechanical CAD, Custom PCBs, Firmware, Tooling, and Unit BOM Economics.
posts.excerpt: A comprehensive financial and engineering guide to the true costs of developing, prototyping, and manufacturing a custom industrial machine or automated commercial kiosk in India. Explore mechanical fabrication, custom PCB electronics, firmware, tooling capital expenditures, prototype iterations, and 60%–75% cost efficiencies compared to Western development.

posts.title: How to Choose a Product Engineering Partner
posts.subtitle: A Founder's Guide to Evaluating Technical Depth, Multidisciplinary Ownership, DFM Rigor & True Commercial Engineering Costs.
posts.excerpt: Why choosing a product engineering partner is a critical founder decision, not an outsourcing contract. Explore the 5 red flags of pseudo-engineering firms, the 4 non-negotiable core disciplines (CAD, PCB, Firmware, Tooling), 100% IP ownership terms, transparent milestone pricing, and how to transition prototypes into certified volume manufacturing without expensive rework.

posts.title: AI + Computer Vision for Industrial Automation
posts.subtitle: Edge-AI Architectures, TensorRT Quantization, Global Shutter Optics, and Sub-50ms Defect Classification on Physical Assembly Lines.
posts.excerpt: A senior AI engineer's guide to deploying computer vision and edge-AI models on automated industrial machines. Explore global shutter camera physics, telecentric optics, TensorRT INT8 quantization, embedded NPU hardware (Jetson Orin vs NXP i.MX8), microsecond strobe synchronization, and real-time pneumatic reject actuation.
